title: The Leftovers
description:

An unexpected ally helps Kevin; Mapleton is plunged into chaos by the Guilty Remnant's elaborate Memorial Day initiative; Holy Wayne grants a final wish; Tom copes with his new reality; Nora makes a decision.

Kevin, Nora and Jill try to pick up the pieces in the aftermath of the Mapleton riots; Nora makes an impulsive choice; Kevin becomes entangled in the Murphy family's problems.

title: The Leftovers
description:

title: The Leftovers
description:

Nora awakens in the midst of an earthquake to find Kevin missing; the Murphys are left reeling after Evie's disappearance; Kevin returns home with no memory of the night before; an old enemy returns.

title: The Leftovers
description:

Rev. Matt Jamison takes his wife outside Miracle to seek answers about her condition; Matt struggles to keep Mary safe from desperate tourists outside the town's gates.

title: The Leftovers

Nora is irritated by unexpected visitors; Kevin's predicament becomes impossible to ignore; Erika finds an unlikely ally and reveals haunting secrets.

Nora gives Kevin and Jill some news; Laurie makes a rash decision; Kevin explores his options to tackle a problem.

title: The Leftovers
description:

Questions and answers emerge in the wake of Kevin's desperate decision to vanquish Patti; the world adjusts to the repercussions of what comes next.

title: The Leftovers
description:

Meg suffers a personal loss and heads out on a pilgrimage to Miracle; after a fallout with Laurie, Tom seeks to reunite with Meg.

title: The Leftovers
description:

Kevin comes clean to John about his connection to Evie's disappearance; Miracle faces an unexpected threat on the fourth anniversary of the Departure.

title: The Leftovers
description:

Three years after Miracle, Texas, was overrun by the Guilty Remnant, Kevin Garvey returns to his role as chief of police; as the seventh anniversary of the Sudden Departure approaches, many believe another apocalyptic event will happen.

title: The Leftovers
description:

As a fraud investigator for the Department of Sudden Departure, Nora travels to St. Louis to investigate a possible scam that involves convincing family members of the Departed of a way to see their loved ones again.

title: The Leftovers
description:

Kevin and Nora travel to Australia, where she continues to track down the masterminds of an elaborate con; Kevin catches a glimpse of a face from the past and must confront the traumatic events of three years earlier.

title: The Leftovers
description:
S03 E05 — It's a Matt, Matt, Matt, Matt World
Convinced that Kevin's destiny requires him to be in Miracle for the seventh anniversary of the Departure, Matt Jamison heads to Australia in an effort to bring Kevin home.

title: The Leftovers
description:
S03 E06 — Certified
Laurie Garvey, a former therapist, must become one again as she heads to Australia to help Nora and Kevin along their paths.

title: The Leftovers
description:

On a mission of mercy, Kevin assumes an alternate identity.

title: The Leftovers
description:

The story of Kevin, Nora and others comes to an end.

title: Mother Mary
description: Preparing a comeback, the reunion between a pop icon and the legendary stylist she betrayed spirals into a supernatural reckoning.

title: The Strangers: Chapter 2
description: After learning that their victim, Maya, is still alive, three masked maniacs return to finish the job. With nowhere to run and no one to trust, Maya finds herself in a fight for survival against psychopaths who'll kill anyone who stands in their way.

title: The Cabin in the Woods
description: Two unseen scientists manipulate the gory goings-on at a backwoods cabin inhabited by a group of unsuspecting college friends (Kristen Connolly, Chris Hemsworth, Anna Hutchison).

title: Blumhouse's Truth or Dare
description: A game of truth or dare results in fatalities when an unknown entity penalizes participants for lying or declining challenges.

title: Supergirl
description: When an unexpected and ruthless adversary strikes too close to home, Supergirl reluctantly joins forces with an unlikely companion for an interstellar journey of vengeance and justice.

title: Superman
description: Tech billionaire Lex Luthor seizes the opportunity to get the Man of Steel out of the way for good. Will intrepid reporter Lois Lane and Superman's four-legged companion, Krypto, be able to help him before it's too late?

title: Aquaman
description: Aquaman must retrieve the legendary Trident of Atlan to save the underwater city of Atlantis -- and the surface world -- from his power-hungry brother.

title: Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom
description: Black Manta wields the power of the mythic Black Trident to unleash an ancient and malevolent force. Hoping to end his reign of terror, Aquaman forges an unlikely alliance with his brother to protect their kingdom and save the world from destruction.

title: Greenland
description: A family embarks on a perilous journey as a planet-killing comet hurtles toward Earth. As the countdown to the global apocalypse approaches zero, their incredible trek culminates in a desperate and last-minute flight to a possible safe haven.

title: Greenland 2: Migration
description: In the aftermath of a comet strike that decimated most of the planet, the Garrity family must leave the safety of their Greenland bunker to traverse a shattered world in search of a new home.

title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)
description: A washed-up actor (Michael Keaton), whose previous claim to fame was his portrayal of a popular superhero, attempts to recapture his past glory by mounting a Broadway play.

title: Ready Player One
description: In 2045, the creator of a virtual reality universe promises his fortune to the first person to discover a digital Easter egg. Soon, young Wade Watts finds himself in a reality-bending treasure hunt through the mysterious and fantastical world.

title: Jodorowsky's Dune
description: Filmmaker Alejandro Jodorowsky discusses how he would have adapted Frank Herbert's classic sci-fi novel "Dune" for the big screen.

title: Dune
description: Paul Atreides, a brilliant and gifted young man born into a great destiny beyond his understanding, must travel to the most dangerous planet in the universe to ensure the future of his family and his people.

title: Dune: Part Two
description: Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while seeking revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the universe, he must prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.

title: The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
